name: Finish The Kallichore Archive
hint: The Academy wants its old records back
howTo: Finish the mission The Kallichore Archive. Provost Baird gives it at the Galatia Academy after you finish Extract 'Researcher' for Academician Sebestyen.
description: Finished the mission The Kallichore Archive.

name: Finish Finding Coureuse
hint: A scientist in hiding is wanted back
howTo: Finish the mission Finding Coureuse. Provost Baird gives it at the Galatia Academy in the same talk as The Kallichore Archive.

name: Finish Project Ziggurat
hint: Learn what Tri-Tachyon hid in the dark
howTo: Finish the mission Project Ziggurat. Academician Sebestyen hails you when you dock at the Galatia Academy after The Kallichore Archive and Finding Coureuse. It ends when you report the scan of the Ziggurat to Provost Baird.

name: Defeat the Ziggurat
hint: Something still guards Alpha Site
howTo: Defeat the Ziggurat in battle at Alpha Site, the system the mission Project Ziggurat leads to.
description: Defeated the Ziggurat at Alpha Site.

name: Return the ISS Hamatsu
hint: An old freighter has an owner who misses it
howTo: Recover the derelict ISS Hamatsu at Alpha Site, the system the mission Project Ziggurat leads to, and transfer it to Callisto Ibrahim on Agreus.
description: Returned the ISS Hamatsu to Callisto Ibrahim.

name: Finish At The Gates
hint: Make the Gates work again
howTo: Finish the mission At The Gates. Academician Sebestyen hails you when you dock at the Galatia Academy once you have scanned the Ziggurat for Project Ziggurat. It ends when you return to the Academy with Elissa Zal and the working Janus Device.
description: Finished the mission At The Gates.

name: Finish Abyssal Space Oddity
hint: An academician is curious about the Abyss
howTo: Finish the mission Abyssal Space Oddity. After the first cycle, with the Transverse Jump ability, a message from Academician Elek can arrive when you dock with your transponder on at a market of size 4 or larger that has a comm relay and is not pirate, Luddic Path or Luddic Church. Finding his sensor array first also starts it.
description: Finished the mission Abyssal Space Oddity.

name: Finish The Usurpers
hint: Get involved in Sindrian politics
howTo: Finish the mission The Usurpers. Visit bars at Sindrian Diktat markets until a security raid happens. Later, Yannick Ram contacts you when you dock at a Diktat market. It ends with your last report to Dolos Macario on Sindria.

name: Finish Princess of Persea
hint: Accept an invitation to a ball
howTo: Finish the mission Princess of Persea. With a Hegemony commission, and after you have met High Hegemon Daud, Caspian Sang can invite you in a Hegemony bar to a ball on Eventide in the Samarra system. Any ending counts.
description: Finished the mission Princess of Persea.

name: Win the duel on Eventide
hint: Settle a matter of honor with a blade
howTo: Win the duel at the ball on Eventide during the mission Princess of Persea.

name: Finish Pilgrim's Path
hint: Visit the holy places of Ludd
howTo: Finish the mission Pilgrim's Path. It starts when, on leaving the shrine on Jangala, Gilead or Beholder Station, you talk to the novice and let the Curate upload the shrine coordinates. Visit the six shrines (Jangala, Hesperus, Gilead, Volturn, Killa, Beholder Station), then return to the shrine on Gilead.

name: Finish Knight Errant
hint: Look for a missing Knight of Ludd
howTo: Finish the mission Knight Errant. Archcurate Jaspis on Gilead offers it after you finish Pilgrim's Path. It ends when you return to her with Jethro Bornanew or with news of his death.

name: Finish False Idols
hint: Help a Knight look into a relic
howTo: Finish the mission False Idols. After Knight Errant, unless you helped fake Bornanew's death, Jethro Bornanew contacts you when you dock at a Luddic Church market with your transponder on and no atrocities on your record. It ends with your report to Gideon Oak on Hesperus.

name: Find the lost Luddic heretics
hint: Some of the faithful have gone missing
howTo: Finish the mission The Stray Flock. A Luddic Church contact, or someone in a bar at a Luddic Church market, asks you to search a star system for a lost group of Luddic heretics. Find them there and report back.
description: Finished the mission The Stray Flock.

name: Finish Passage To Volturn
hint: Give some strangers a ride
howTo: Finish the mission Passage To Volturn. An old man in the bar on Asharu asks for transport to Volturn in the Askonia system. He does not ask a fleet with a capital ship or a captain with a Sindrian Diktat commission. Any ending counts.
description: Finished the mission Passage To Volturn.

name: Recover the planetkiller
hint: Find a weapon that should have stayed lost
howTo: Salvage the planetkiller at the end of the mission The Scythe of Orion. The mission starts when a Luddic Path base commander tells you about it while the Luddic Path is active on your colonies, or when you destroy the Remnant Nexus that holds the data.

name: Earn Kanta's protection
hint: Make a powerful pirate friend
howTo: With at least one colony, ask the Station King at Kanta's Den in the Magec system for an audience with Warlord Kanta, then offer her a gift or a favor.

name: Hold a million credits
hint: Fill your accounts
howTo: Have 1,000,000 credits at one time.

name: Found a colony
hint: Claim a world of your own
howTo: Own a colony.

name: Grow a colony to size 6
hint: Let one world prosper
howTo: Own a colony of size 6 or larger.
reward: Unlocks the rule Charter of Governors.

name: Own five colonies
hint: Expand your domain far and wide
howTo: Own five colonies at the same time.

name: Win a battle
hint: Come out of a fight on top
howTo: Win a battle. A battle you join on another fleet's side counts.

name: Beat a fleet twice your size
hint: Win when badly outnumbered
howTo: Win a battle in which the enemy side has at least twice the fleet points of your side.
description: Beat a fleet twice your size.

name: Defeat an orbital station
hint: Bring down a fortress in orbit
howTo: Win a battle with an orbital station on the enemy side.

name: Defeat a Remnant fleet
hint: Fight the machines the AI Wars left behind
howTo: Win a battle with a Remnant fleet on the enemy side.

name: Defeat an Omega, Threat or Dweller fleet
hint: Fight what waits in the Abyss
howTo: Win a battle with an Omega, Threat or Shrouded Dweller fleet on the enemy side.
description: Defeated an Omega, Threat or Dweller fleet.

name: Destroy a shrouded ship
hint: Kill something that hides in the Abyss
howTo: Destroy or disable a Shrouded Dweller ship before Sol arrives in the Sector. Later kills are not recorded.

name: Bring Sol into the Sector
hint: Bring an old star home
howTo: Finish the quest Transferring Sol. From level 10, with the Transverse Jump ability, accept the researcher's lead in any bar, talk to Glasya-Labolas on Eochu Bres, destroy a shrouded ship, then use the Translocator at the signal beyond the northern edge of the map. Skipping the quest at Glasya-Labolas also counts.

name: Reach Sol
hint: Visit the cradle of humanity
howTo: Enter the Sol system.

name: Deter the Sol crisis
hint: Make the Sector leave Sol alone
howTo: Finish the mission The Deterrent. After the first Reckoning of the crisis Discovering the Past, destroy the three fleets that each guard a planetkiller: Sol Base Loot Armada, Unholy Relic Purge Fleet and Origin Found.

name: Play the slot machine
hint: Try your luck in a back room
howTo: Pull the lever of the slot machine in a gambling den. Every port of size 6 or larger has one, under Visit the gambling den.

name: Win at the slot machine
hint: Let the reels pay out
howTo: Win a prize on a pull of the slot machine in a gambling den.

name: Own a Cloning Megafactory
hint: Grow a population in vats
howTo: On one of your colonies, build Clone Vat Experiments, upgrade it to Cloning Industry and then to Cloning Megafactory.

name: Supergrowth
hint: Give the vats the best the Sector has
howTo: Own a Cloning Megafactory with an Omega core and a Pristine Nanoforge installed.
description: Ran a Cloning Megafactory with an Omega core and a Pristine Nanoforge.

name: Reverse-engineer 10 weapons
hint: Take weapons apart to learn how they work
howTo: Build a Reverse Engineering Hub on one of your colonies and put weapons into its Reverse Engineering Storage until 10 different weapons are reverse-engineered.

name: Reverse-engineer a ship
hint: Take a ship apart to learn how it works
howTo: Upgrade a Reverse Engineering Hub to Reverse Engineering Hub III and put a ship into its Reverse Engineering Storage until it is reverse-engineered.

name: Start with a Starter Pack
hint: Begin with a prepared fleet
howTo: Apply a StarterPack template to a campaign: tick Apply automatically on new game in the editor, or run the console command starterpack.
description: Started a campaign with a Starter Pack.

name: Sign a contract
hint: Take a job offered in a bar
howTo: Sign a contract offered in a bar, under Look over the contract.

name: Grow a colony past size 10
hint: Grow a colony beyond its natural limit
howTo: Make an Omega core the administrator of a colony of size 10 and let it grow to size 11.

name: Build an Ecumenopolis
hint: Turn a planet into a single city
howTo: Grow a colony governed by an Omega core to size 13. It becomes an Ecumenopolis by itself.

name: Train an officer under an Omega core
hint: Give your officers an inhuman teacher
howTo: Install an Omega core in an Academy (Industrial Evolution) on one of your colonies while an officer is in your fleet. Mercenaries do not count.

name: Meet Chicken
hint: A tech dealer is open for business
howTo: Done as soon as a campaign runs with Chicken's Tech Shop on. Chicken is a contact at Chicken's Roost from the start.

name: Max out Chicken's Tech Market
hint: Become a tech dealer's most trusted courier
howTo: Raise Chicken's Tech Market to level 5 by finishing contracts for Chicken. The credit rewards of the contracts count: 700,000 in total from level 1.

name: Visit the Great Mall
hint: Go shopping in a nebula
howTo: Enter the Gilgamesh Nebula system.

name: Refit a ship at the Ledger
hint: Have yard work done off the books
howTo: Buy an S-mod slot or Stat tuning in the Shipyard tab of the Ledger and fit it to one of your ships.
description: Refitted a ship at the Ledger.

name: The Ziggurat Gambit
hint: Face the Sector's most feared phase ship on hard terms
howTo: With Plated Foes III and Phase Shadows III on and no positive rules, defeat the Ziggurat.
description: With Plated Foes III and Phase Shadows III on and no positive rules, defeat the Ziggurat.

name: Iron Gauntlet
hint: Keep winning against tougher enemies
howTo: With Hardened Foes II, Deadly Foes II and Plated Foes II on and no positive rules, win 20 battles.
description: With Hardened Foes II, Deadly Foes II and Plated Foes II on and no positive rules, win 20 battles.

name: The Lone Admiral
hint: Win with fewer officers and weaker crews
howTo: With Short-Staffed II, Green Crews II and Garbled Orders II on and no positive rules, win 10 battles.
description: With Short-Staffed II, Green Crews II and Garbled Orders II on and no positive rules, win 10 battles.

name: Blitz
hint: Win quickly against fast, hard-hitting enemies
howTo: With Hasty Foes II and Deadly Foes II on and no positive rules, win 10 battles within 90 days.
description: With Hasty Foes II and Deadly Foes II on and no positive rules, win 10 battles within 90 days.

name: Big Game
hint: Take on fleets far larger than yours
howTo: With Seasoned Officers II and Antagonism I on and no positive rules, beat a fleet twice your size 3 times within 180 days.
description: With Seasoned Officers II and Antagonism I on and no positive rules, beat a fleet twice your size 3 times within 180 days.

name: Junkyard Baron
hint: Win with ships that are falling apart
howTo: With Festering Damage II, Shattering Hulls II and Slow Repairs II on and at most 10 points of positive rules, win 15 battles.
description: With Festering Damage II, Shattering Hulls II and Slow Repairs II on and at most 10 points of positive rules, win 15 battles.

name: The Long Night
hint: Endure a hostile Sector for a long time
howTo: With Swelling Ranks III, Pristine Foes II and Swift Pursuers II on and no positive rules, last 365 days.
description: With Swelling Ranks III, Pristine Foes II and Swift Pursuers II on and no positive rules, last 365 days.

name: Lean Years
hint: Keep the fleet going on short supplies
howTo: With Famine II, Hungry Fleet III and Leaky Tanks II on and no positive rules, last 180 days.
description: With Famine II, Hungry Fleet III and Leaky Tanks II on and no positive rules, last 180 days.

name: Merchant's Gauntlet
hint: Get rich where trade is taxed hard
howTo: With Price Gouging III and Skimming Clerks II on and no positive rules, hold a million credits.
description: With Price Gouging III and Skimming Clerks II on and no positive rules, hold a million credits.

name: Colonial Empire
hint: Build a domain out of unruly colonies
howTo: With Restless Colonists II, Crumbling Works II and Remote Colonies II on and no positive rules, own five colonies.
description: With Restless Colonists II, Crumbling Works II and Remote Colonies II on and no positive rules, own five colonies.

name: Ordo Hunt
hint: Hunt machines that do not tire
howTo: With Overclocked Foes II, Tireless Foes II and Hardened Foes II on and no positive rules, defeat 3 Remnant fleets.
description: With Overclocked Foes II, Tireless Foes II and Hardened Foes II on and no positive rules, defeat 3 Remnant fleets.

name: Fortress Breaker
hint: Crack fortified positions
howTo: With Plated Foes II, Thick-Hulled Foes II and Long Guns II on and no positive rules, defeat 3 orbital stations.
description: With Plated Foes II, Thick-Hulled Foes II and Long Guns II on and no positive rules, defeat 3 orbital stations.

name: Pilgrim's Ordeal
hint: Walk a holy road the hard way
howTo: With Famine I, Heavy Drives I and Slow Repairs II on and no positive rules, finish Pilgrim's Path.
description: With Famine I, Heavy Drives I and Slow Repairs II on and no positive rules, finish Pilgrim's Path.

name: Sol Expedition
hint: Bring home a lost star under pressure
howTo: With Swelling Ranks II, Long Guns II and Heavy Drives I on and no positive rules, bring Sol into the Sector.
description: With Swelling Ranks II, Long Guns II and Heavy Drives I on and no positive rules, bring Sol into the Sector.

name: High Roller
hint: Win at the reels while money is tight
howTo: With Price Gouging II and Skimming Clerks II on and no positive rules, win at the slot machine 10 times.
description: With Price Gouging II and Skimming Clerks II on and no positive rules, win at the slot machine 10 times.

name: Omega Apprentice
hint: Find your officers a strange teacher under fire
howTo: With Phase Shadows II and Rapid Loaders II on and no positive rules, train an officer under an Omega core.
description: With Phase Shadows II and Rapid Loaders II on and no positive rules, train an officer under an Omega core.

name: Ascendant
hint: Raise a colony beyond its limits in hard times
howTo: With Restless Colonists II, Crumbling Works II and Harsh Worlds II on and no positive rules, grow a colony past size 10.
description: With Restless Colonists II, Crumbling Works II and Harsh Worlds II on and no positive rules, grow a colony past size 10.
